schema_integration: Owner source inventory; SDK01 common scheduler consumption is NOT_IMPLEMENTED_OR_QUALIFIED. This is not a replacement scheduler or a passing receipt.
required_environment: Installed Xmake and the exact shared language/toolchain closure for each selected source and pointer width
Exact qualified uwvm2-ros runtime asset, module/import/features and explicit permission/audit deployment
Applicable installed official simulator/provider with pinned ROS release, ABI/RMW and full library identity
Real guest ROS client/callback/feedback/sensor/file behavior in Wasm; no host business-client fallback
Permission-denied/no-native-effect and audited reverse-feedback evidence, plus required lifecycle/fault scenarios
non_success_conditions: Missing runtime, provider, toolchain, grant or actual mandatory scenario
Zero selected/executed tests or a missing/quarantined required example
Only source compilation, static metadata, old receipt inspection or native reference execution
Lost resource/lock/actor identity or missing complete retirement

manual_SSH_resources.global_lock_lifetime: All heavy descendants through full retirement

CI_resource_policy: SDK01 owns Linux GitHub workflow and bounded parent/child Xmake scheduling; GitHub job resource measurements do not qualify manual SSH execution.
